scl_policy.excluded_description: Clouds, shadows, water, defective pixels, etc. (all other SCL classes)
scl_policy.eligible_description: Coverage denominator: SCL classes 1..11 carry an actual scene classification. Class 0 (NO DATA) and missing/NaN pixels carry no observation and are excluded from the denominator entirely. Cloudy/shadowed pixels stay eligible but count as not valid.

coverage_policy.definition: valid_pixel_fraction = mean(valid_flags) / mean(eligible_flags) over the parcel, where valid_flags = 1 for SCL in [4,5] and eligible_flags = 1 for SCL in [1..11]
coverage_policy.grid: Numerator and denominator are both computed from the SCL band alone (20 m native resolution) on the same grid and aggregated over the same parcel geometry, so the ratio of means equals the ratio of pixel counts.
coverage_policy.ndvi_grid: B04/B08 are 10 m native. The SCL-derived cloud mask is resampled onto the NDVI grid with nearest-neighbour (resample_cube_spatial, method=near) before masking; no arithmetic mixes 10 m and 20 m values.
coverage_policy.zero_denominator: If the eligible mean is 0 or missing the fraction is null (never fabricated).
